### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var _v462 = FontFile.new()
	_v462.get_glyph_advance(2147483647, -2147483648, 2147483647)
	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29985924/mrp.zip)
